title: Revenge in Red
description: Betrayed by everyone she loved, she returns with a new name and a colder heart.

seasons.title: The Return
seasons.description: The queen returns to her throne.

parts.text: She adjusted her red dress, the color of blood and warning.
They thought they had destroyed her. They thought she was just a memory.
But memories have a way of coming back to haunt you. And she was the worst kind of ghost.
